First Thursday’s @ The Capri

Thu, Feb 4, 2016 · 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM · Capri Theater

When
Thu, Feb 4, 2016 · 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM
Where
Capri Theater
2027 West Broadway, Minneapolis, MN

Share

Noteworthy films with good conversation to follow on the first Thursday of every month at 7:00pm.

Tickets $5 at the door or in advance online at mspfilm.org.

The Film Society has a long track record of bringing the very best in independent international cinema to audiences throughout Minnesota. Filmmakers will be invited to meet and discuss their films with audiences each night.

Watch mspfilm.org and our website for schedule updates.
